census_summary.plainly: FORTY of eighty-four render-auditable parameter instances are dead — 48%. The flake block was not unusually bad; it was representative.

structural_patterns.common_microtexture_block: consumed ONLY by MARBLED — dead in 8 of 9 families
structural_patterns.press_compressed_block: superseded silently when the compaction block was added — the same quantity declared twice, one copy dead
structural_patterns.builder_constants_shadow_contracts: POWDER_SATIN, BAKED and CREAM surface_roughness are overridden by hardcoded builder values (0.43/0.38/continuity) — the render distinction is REAL but the contract account of it is wrong: DECLARED_BUT_DIFFERENTLY_REALIZED
structural_patterns.never_wired: micronormal_correlation_mm, edge_packing, surface_density, size_distribution, shape_class, depth_distribution, coordinate_mapping, flake_orientation, sparkle_distribution

census_summary.load_bearing_adjudication: NO banked verdict rests on a dead parameter: every measured number came from real rendered frames and dead parameters by definition did not shape them. What falls is contract integrity — the family definitions mis-describe which declared knobs produced the measured distinctions. FLAGGED NODES, chain not stopped: (1) contract cleanup (remove or realize dead params — identity-moving, owner-visible); (2) satin/baked/cream roughness builder-constants reconciled with contracts; (3) NOT_REALIZED registry extended to the full census.

reprobe_and_split.instrument_failure_mode_addressed: the frame-delta probe can false-kill a clamped or boundary-pinned parameter (proven twice: reflectance at the Metallic clamp, granularity_forbidden validator-realized). All 40 dead verdicts re-examined.
reprobe_and_split.method: static reachability on the builder sources: a parameter whose block+leaf is never referenced by its family builder cannot arrive at any socket at any value — the plumbing question settled without a probe; bidirectional render probes reserved for READ-but-identical cases
reprobe_and_split.corrected_number: 48% stands — but as a plumbing measurement, not a frame-delta reading; the only READ-class cases were the two false-kills already corrected by inspection

per_verdict_live_parameters.what_a_PASS_actually_proved: each verdict certifies the REALIZED subset of its families, not the families as written; these lists are that subset. BUILDER_CONSTANT marks a rendered property whose value comes from shader code, not the contract.

cream: microtexture zeroed by family override (and unplumbed anyway)

phase3_retrospective.micronormal_amplitude_is_live: confirmed in the live 52% — powder_materials.py feeds it into _bump as both divisor and bump amplitude, and the audit measured it at 3.4x frame response
phase3_retrospective.what_this_settles: had the satin correction gone ahead it would have been a REAL change to a REAL parameter — the refusal was a genuine decision with a genuine cost avoided. Given 48% of the contract is inert, the one family change M6 ever contemplated landing on a live parameter was LUCK, not design, and this record says so.

product_realization_line.declared_gate: RIGS_MAY_PROCEED / PRODUCT_REALIZATION_BLOCKED: rig work (BAKED, marbling, remaining controls) measures real frames and the census does not touch its validity. ES3083/FB3093 product realization, observability, the trace and the boards CONSUME THE FAMILY DEFINITIONS — building products from a contract where half the declared parameters are inert makes the product spec and the certified render two different objects, and the divergence propagates toward M7 artwork and manufacturing intent. Product realization is BLOCKED until contract integrity is repaired (the three flagged nodes).
